failure_history.reason:
1. `npm run check` cannot pass on a GitHub runner. `check` starts with `verify:testing-ledger` → `.agents/skills/testing-ledger/scripts/validate.sh`, which hard-fails when `$HOME/.agents/skills/testing-framework/SKILL.md` is missing (line ~112: `test -f "$FRAMEWORK_DIR/SKILL.md" || exit 1`). That skill is not vendored in the repo (`.agents/skills/` has `testing-ledger` but no `testing-framework`). Reproduced: `HOME=$(mktemp -d) bash .agents/skills/testing-ledger/scripts/validate.sh` → `global testing-framework unavailable … exit 1`. So the "Repo checks" step fails before any test runs and the run can never conclude `success`. Fix: skip the global-skill validation when `TESTING_FRAMEWORK_DIR` is absent, or have CI run only the repo-local checks (`verify:ledger-migration`, `verify:ledger-progress`, `node --check`).

2. Workflow references a file this commit does not add. `ci.yml` uses `node-version-file: .nvmrc`, but `.nvmrc` does not exist at e3c2b73 (`git cat-file -e e3c2b73:.nvmrc` → fatal). It is added later by 92ac55e (ENV-01). At this sha, `actions/setup-node` fails with "node-version-file could not be found". Fix: add `.nvmrc` (20) in this commit or use `node-version: 20`.

3. Acceptance clause 2 is unmet, not merely pending. `script/verify_ci.sh` requires `origin/$BRANCH == HEAD` and a completed `pull_request` run for that exact sha. Branch `cursor/bcl-r1-e678` has no remote counterpart, and `gh workflow list` reports no `CI` workflow at all — so no run exists to verify. Cannot close the lane until the branch is pushed, a PR opened, and the run is green.

findings.title: Logging gap: the API and apps write no structured logs to collect
findings.observed: developer-observability collect (project likeminded, 2026-11-14 00:58 and 01:32 IST) found only old committed artifacts (output/*/run.log, .playwright-cli console logs). check, test:auth and smoke:mvp runs on #16-#18 produced no collectable events.
findings.recommendation: Have the Node API (and smoke/test scripts) write JSONL events (route, status, duration, error class) to a known path and register it as a collector source for project likeminded; do this first in the next batch.
findings.verification: Pending: a fresh smoke:mvp run shows up as Likeminded events in observability_diagnose.

findings.title: PROGRESS.md marks stale_pass done but the ledger still has stale controls
findings.observed: npm run goal:next on main b14843c reported ledger_progress_ok=no: 56 iOS and 33 macOS controls are still stale_pass while PROGRESS.md marks that work done.
findings.recommendation: Re-proof the stale controls (macos:cua-reproof / testing-ledger runs) or correct PROGRESS.md so verify:ledger-progress agrees; re-check after #18 lands.
findings.verification: Pending: npm run verify:ledger-progress passes on main.

findings.title: Node 20 is not installed on the Mac, so tests ran on Node 24
findings.observed: nvm lists lts/iron (v20.20.2) but it is not installed; the 01:28 run used Node v24.14.1 and the 01:55 run used Homebrew v23.6.1 (nvm current: system). Render runs Node 20, so local results can drift between runs.
findings.recommendation: Install Node 20 with nvm and run the checks on it once, or pin .nvmrc to match Render, so local results match production.
findings.verification: Pending: check, test:auth and smoke:mvp pass on Node 20.

findings.title: Shared observability store grew from 825 KB to about 92 MB in three collects
findings.observed: Three collects on 2026-11-14 grew ~/.local/share/developer-observability/collected/findings.json from 825 KB to ~92 MB, mostly version_scopes and session_timelines from re-scanning Samantha sources; collector warned collector_outputs uses 1.7 GiB (warn at 1.0 GiB).
findings.recommendation: Owned by the Observability bot (developer-observability plugin): bound version_scopes/session_timelines or scope collect to --project-dir sources only. Likeminded side: avoid repeated full collects until fixed.
findings.verification: Pending: repeated collects keep the file near its original size.

findings.title: Findings were not recorded on the change list during the first test run
findings.observed: Guru asked at 01:39 IST whether issues were being added; the tracker was still empty although the PR test run (01:28-01:34 IST) had found 5 issues.
findings.recommendation: Record each finding on the tracker as soon as it is observed, and put the tracker update into every test-run brief.
findings.verification: This run recorded PR-01 evidence on the tracker while the merge was still in progress (2026-11-14 IST), instead of waiting for the final report.

verification_evidence.check: tracker updated during the run, including after push
verification_evidence.reference: PR-01 moved to awaiting_verification when the branch was pushed and checks were green

findings.title: Native iOS and macOS builds of merged #18 are not verified yet
findings.observed: #18 merged into main (01b536a) on Guru's call without a native compile. Earlier, xcodebuild -list spent over 3 minutes resolving SPM packages and was stopped; MacAppState.swift, SettingsPrototypeView.swift, both Info.plists and project.yml changed in the merge.
findings.recommendation: Resolve SPM once, then do an unsigned build of the iOS and macOS schemes on main, then verify:ios-screens and verify:macos-screens.
findings.verification: Pending: both schemes compile on 3f6c98a or a later head.

findings.title: gh HTTPS push uses a pull-only account; pushes only work over SSH
findings.observed: Pushing codex/apple-testflight-mvp over HTTPS as the active gh account openclaw-gurusharan returned 403; SSH as ingpoc succeeded (7c7b9f5..3f6c98a).
findings.recommendation: Set the clone's origin push URL to SSH (git@github.com:ingpoc/Like-minded-app.git), or have Guru decide which gh account should be active.
findings.verification: Pending: git push from the clone works without a URL override.

findings.title: GitHub connector can no longer mark PRs ready or merge in this repo
findings.observed: 2026-11-14 08:43 IST: markPullRequestReadyForReview and PUT /pulls/18/merge both returned 403 'Resource not accessible by integration', although the same calls worked for #16 and #17 at ~01:38 IST. The merge went through via gh on the Mac with the ingpoc token.
findings.recommendation: Check the GitHub app installation's permissions on ingpoc/Like-minded-app (pull requests and contents write); until then use gh with the ingpoc account for writes.
findings.verification: Pending: the connector can mark a PR ready again.

findings.title: No automatic checks on pull requests, and the API has almost no tests
findings.summary: Nothing checks pull requests automatically, and only the sign-in code has tests.
findings.impact: Broken API changes can merge unnoticed.
findings.done_when: An automatic check on the pull request runs the existing checks, the new API tests and the smoke test, and passes.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:20 IST: main 01b536a has no .github directory; services/api/test holds only auth.test.js, apple-oauth, apple-token and social-auth tests.
findings.recommendation: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml (path filters, concurrency cancel, npm cache, Node 20, free runners) and node --test API tests for health, profile, circles and error paths.

findings.title: The app's local API and the Context Ledger want the same port on the Mac
findings.summary: The app's API and the Context Ledger both want port 8787 on Guru's Mac.
findings.impact: Running the API with defaults on the Mac fails or the docs' health check hits the wrong service.
findings.done_when: Local runs on the Mac use a port that does not clash, and the repo instructions say which.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:20 IST: services/api/src/server.js line 97 defaults PORT to 8787 and AGENTS.md says curl 127.0.0.1:8787/health, while lsof shows python3 (Context Ledger, pid 1360) listening on localhost:8787.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: move local default (e.g. 8790) or document PORT override for this Mac; not changed in this round.

findings.title: The change-list tool records no failed-first, root-cause or fix-verified steps
findings.summary: The change-list tool does not record the failed-first, root-cause and fix-verified steps for each fix.
findings.impact: A reviewer cannot audit that each fix was shown failing before it was fixed.
findings.done_when: The change-list tool records failed-first, root-cause and fix-verified steps for each fix and shows them on the page.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:22 IST: bcl 0.1.70 scripts/events.py only supports job events start/finish/failed_start/incomplete and stage_start/stage_finish; grep for issue_failed_first, root_cause_identified, fix_verified across the plugin and developer-observability found nothing.
findings.recommendation: Owned by the batched-change-list plugin: add trail events per lane; pass to the plugin owner.

findings.title: Swift package resolve hangs with no activity on Xcode 27
findings.summary: Downloading the app's Swift packages froze for 12 minutes doing nothing.
findings.impact: Native builds stall unless packages already on disk are reused.
findings.done_when: Package resolve finishes or fails on its own within a few minutes.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:16-09:28 IST: xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies (Xcode 27.0 27A266a) sat at 'Resolve Package Graph' for 12 min, 0% CPU, no sockets, holding the livekit-uniffi artifact lock in TMPDIR; curl fetched the same 5.5 MB zip in 1.1 s. Killed pid 68536. Same pattern as the >3 min xcodebuild -list on 2026-11-14.
findings.recommendation: Build script now reuses checkouts that match Package.resolved offline and caps online resolve with a timeout; root cause in SwiftPM still open (try clearing ~/Library/Caches/org.swift.swiftpm artifacts lock or a newer Xcode).

findings.title: The change-list tool assumes the fix job itself makes the commit
findings.summary: Fix work done directly by a helper, not through a coding tool, is recorded as a failed fix.
findings.impact: Lanes look failed and the failure streak grows even when the fix is good; parallel lanes in one folder can be credited with each other's commits.
findings.done_when: The tool can credit a fix commit made by the named implementer, per lane.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:22 IST: three bcl fix jobs (OBS-01, CI-01, ENV-01) whose commits already existed exited 3 'fix job made no commit'; bcl only compares HEAD before and after the job, so a concurrent lane's commit in the same worktree would satisfy it. Plan and finding edits are also refused for as long as any job runs (a 12 min build blocked all tracker writes).
findings.recommendation: Owned by the batched-change-list plugin: compare lane-scoped files or accept a commit sha argument; allow finding adds while a job runs.

findings.title: Review needs a Codex session id even when no Codex was used
findings.summary: The review step refuses to run unless a Codex implementer session is recorded.
findings.impact: Non-Codex implementers must fill a placeholder, so the record no longer says who did the work.
findings.done_when: Review accepts any recorded implementer identity.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:31 IST: bcl job --phase review refused all three lanes: 'review requires codex.implementer_session'. Set it to a Grok Bot executor label via update-plan-group.
findings.recommendation: Owned by the batched-change-list plugin: rename to implementer_session and accept non-Codex implementers.

findings.title: Helper and reviewer jobs record no tokens, model version or cost
findings.summary: Jobs run by Grok Bot helpers and free reviewers show no usage, so cost tracking misses them.
findings.impact: The job table cannot say what each fix or review cost.
findings.done_when: Each fix and review job row shows model, model version, tokens and cost.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:30 IST: every bcl job this round has tokens_source none and tokens null; usage is only read from Codex session files. Grok Bot executor jobs have no collector; OpenCode reviewer usage exists in opencode stats but nothing reads it. No rows were hand-written.
findings.recommendation: Owned by developer-observability and batched-change-list: add collectors for Grok Bot subagent jobs and OpenCode runs (opencode stats or session export).

findings.title: Event log follow-ups from review
findings.summary: Small hardening items the reviewer noted on the new event log.
findings.impact: Low; they matter if the API ever takes real traffic.
findings.done_when: Event serialising cannot throw, and route names group ids.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 OBS-01 review (OpenCode deepseek-v4.1-flash-free): JSON.stringify sits outside the try in events.js; raw pathname makes id routes high-cardinality; appendFileSync is synchronous per request; verify script SKIPs the collect half when the collector is not installed.
findings.recommendation: Move serialisation inside the try, template id segments, consider a buffered stream.

findings.title: The privacy page route is defined twice in the API
findings.summary: The same page route appears twice; the second copy never runs.
findings.impact: Dead code that could confuse future edits.
findings.done_when: Only one privacy route remains and the API tests still pass.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:20 IST: services/api/src/server.js has GET /privacy at lines 475 and 496 (main 01b536a).

findings.title: Three different OpenCode installs are on the Mac's path
findings.summary: Several copies of the free reviewer tool are installed, so it is unclear which one runs.
findings.impact: A stale copy may run, against the fleet rule of one brew install.
findings.done_when: Only the Homebrew copy is on the path.
findings.observed: 2026-11-25 09:29 IST: whence -ap opencode lists ~/.opencode/bin/opencode, ~/.bun/bin/opencode and /opt/homebrew/bin/opencode; reviews here pinned /opt/homebrew/bin/opencode.
findings.recommendation: Guru to remove the ~/.opencode and bun copies (not done here: outside this repo).
